title: Chief Software Engineer

additionalInformation.label: RFIMS Operations, Maintenance and Sustainment award (up to $49.0 million)

description: Led an eight-person software team focused on turning the reusable RFIMS baseline from the original development effort, valued at up to $148.4 million, into an operational system. Owned technical direction, execution planning, security authorization, and deployment of the embedded collection and AWS classification system to operational sites.
highlights: Directed the engineering work required to turn the development baseline across embedded collection systems and AWS GovCloud into an operational capability.
Managed the software budget, schedule, and execution plan for an eight-person team using EVMS and Agile Scrum.
Worked through NIST security controls and audit evidence to obtain Authorization to Operate for deployed systems.
Coordinated internal teams and customer stakeholders to deliver software capabilities to operational sites.
Resolved cross-team technical blockers while providing hands-on implementation support for high-priority work.
